label: Actual roots apprehend through good-general favouring, from finality and the criterion
description: Fix an actual root r at w. Commitment (e) in its weakest favouring form (under ORIGINAL_FINALITY_1 and _2) gives r a favouring determination favours phi. The previous step makes phi good-general, and the cognition criterion gives r an apprehended content about some candidate. The main theorem uses no axioms. Comparator companions (Mathlib axioms): apprehensionControls gives a positive witness and, for each premise, a row where it fails, the others hold and the conclusion fails; its last row is the standing good-general impersonal rival (good-tracking favouring, no apprehension, the criterion failing). criterionTable records how the formal definition classifies: the good-general nature and rational exercise (the same function) are good-general, witnessed without the counterpossible valueless scenario; the D-nature, determined will, proxy and chance are not; a comparator restricted to present inputs is not, whatever it tracks; if betterness is the end-realization ordering itself, nothing is; and with lower action as the ranking a toy least-action law is good-general in the formal sense, while with a value ranking under which its paths do not differ it is not, so the value reading of the ranking is load-bearing. jointConfigurations assembles on one carrier the necessary simple root (the #1892 FirstSourceFrame) with the D-directed, the good-general impersonal and the personal favouring, each with its finality sense and apprehension assignment, and the section 61 replacement omission profile on another carrier. These are structural surrogates, not metaphysical possibilities.
